title: From Managed Security to Cyber Resilience: What We Believe the IDC MarketScape 2026 Asia/Pacific MSS Assessment Means for Security Leaders
content_md: Security leaders across Asia/Pacific are being asked to do more than watch alerts. Boards and regulators want proof that the organization can withstand an attack, contain it fast and recover with minimal disruption. That shift, from managed security to cyber resilience, is reshaping what organizations need from a security partner.
